goal: Fall back to block policy fee rate estimates when the mempool estimator is unready or loading
Prevent fee estimation errors and severe underbidding after node restarts or failed mempool reloads
agreement: Strong support with all review concerns addressed (polespinasa, achow101, instagibbs, tankyleo)
Concept approval for falling back to block policy when mempool estimates fail (achow101, polespinasa)
Confirmed downstream LDK impact and verified by testing that the fix works (instagibbs, tankyleo)
Objections on stats clearing and warmup persistence across restarts were resolved (willcl-ark, davidgumberg)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because fee queries fail or severely underbid after cold starts when mempool estimates are unready
Downstream wallets like LDK actively encountered failures despite valid block policy estimates existing
